column1: # Upstream release tarballs kept as-is in dist/ (not unpacked into vendor/).
# scripts/vendor-update.sh downloads them, build.sh checks the sha256 before
# use. kind prebuilt = upstream's own Linux x86_64 build, used as shipped;
# kind source = compiled by build.sh; kind rpm = a package build.sh only
# checks, installed by podman/Containerfile (runtime stage) with rpm.
